adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, the embed_controller.rb shows that when no topic_id is found, it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` (line 14). However, the test in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb lines 40-44 expects `TopicRetriever.new` to be called directly and `retriever.retrieve` to be invoked. This is a mismatch - the controller enqueues a job, but the test expects synchronous TopicRetriever invocation. The test will fail because TopicRetriever.new is never called directly by the controller; instead Jobs.enqueue is called. This is a real bug in the test code.
